titleEn: Find Building Where Alice and Bob Can Meet
title: 找到 Alice 和 Bob 可以相遇的建筑
summary: 建筑从左到右排列，只有当目标下标更大且目标高度严格更高时才能移动。对每组 Alice、Bob 的起点，返回两人都能到达的最左建筑下标，不存在则返回 -1。
insight: 把起点规范为 left<=right。若两人同楼，或 heights[left]<heights[right]，答案可直接是 right；否则共同目标必须位于 right 右侧且高度严格大于 heights[left]。把这类查询挂在 right 上，扫描建筑时用按高度阈值排序的小根堆维护已经越过右端点的查询，当前高度超过堆顶阈值时即可确定该查询的最左答案。
pitfalls: 查询两个起点的给出顺序不保证从左到右，必须先规范化
同一建筑的查询应直接返回该下标
左楼更矮时可以直接跳到右楼，无需继续搜索
不能直接相遇时阈值是较左起点的高度，此时它不小于右起点高度
目标高度必须严格大于阈值，相等的建筑不能到达
未决查询要在处理其 right 位置之后才入堆，确保目标下标严格更大
扫描结束仍在堆中的查询答案保持 -1

solutions.title: 离线阈值小根堆扫描
solutions.idea: 按右端点激活查询，让第一次超过阈值的建筑成为最左共同目标。
steps: answer 初始化为 -1，并为每个建筑准备待激活查询列表
对每组查询规范化 left、right
同楼或 left 楼更矮时直接回答 right
先弹出所有 threshold<heights[building] 的活动查询并回答 building
再把 waiting[building] 中的查询加入小根堆，使其只能匹配后续建筑

code.java: class Solution { public int[] leftmostBuildingQueries(int[] heights,int[][] queries){List<int[]>[] waiting=new List[heights.length];for(int i=0;i<heights.length;i++)waiting[i]=new ArrayList<>();int[] answer=new int[queries.length];Arrays.fill(answer,-1);for(int index=0;index<queries.length;index++){int left=Math.min(queries[index][0],queries[index][1]),right=Math.max(queries[index][0],queries[index][1]);if(left==right||heights[left]<heights[right])answer[index]=right;else waiting[right].add(new int[]{heights[left],index});}PriorityQueue<int[]> pending=new PriorityQueue<>((first,second)->Integer.compare(first[0],second[0]));for(int building=0;building<heights.length;building++){while(!pending.isEmpty()&&pending.peek()[0]<heights[building]){int[] query=pending.poll();answer[query[1]]=building;}for(int[] query:waiting[building])pending.add(query);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun leftmostBuildingQueries(heights:IntArray,queries:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{val waiting=Array(heights.size){mutableListOf<IntArray>()};val answer=IntArray(queries.size){-1};for(index in queries.indices){val left=minOf(queries[index][0],queries[index][1]);val right=maxOf(queries[index][0],queries[index][1]);if(left==right||heights[left]<heights[right])answer[index]=right else waiting[right].add(intArrayOf(heights[left],index))};val pending=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>(compareBy<IntArray>{it[0]});for(building in heights.indices){while(pending.isNotEmpty()&&pending.peek()[0]<heights[building]){val query=pending.poll();answer[query[1]]=building};for(query in waiting[building])pending.add(query)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> leftmostBuildingQueries(vector<int>& heights,vector<vector<int>>& queries){vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> waiting(heights.size());vector<int> answer(queries.size(),-1);for(int index=0;index<(int)queries.size();++index){int left=min(queries[index][0],queries[index][1]),right=max(queries[index][0],queries[index][1]);if(left==right||heights[left]<heights[right])answer[index]=right;else waiting[right].push_back({heights[left],index});}priority_queue<pair<int,int>,vector<pair<int,int>>,greater<pair<int,int>>> pending;for(int building=0;building<(int)heights.size();++building){while(!pending.empty()&&pending.top().first<heights[building]){int index=pending.top().second;pending.pop();answer[index]=building;}for(auto query:waiting[building])pending.push(query);}return answer;} };
